title: Vegan Orange Pudding Bread Pudding
description: A moist and flavorful bread pudding infused with orange zest and orange juice, perfect for a dessert or snack.

ingredients.name: non-dairy milk
ingredients.notes: such as almond or soy milk

instructions: Cut the bread into 1-inch cubes and place in a large mixing bowl.
In a separate bowl, whisk together non-dairy milk, non-dairy butter, sugar, and vanilla extract.
Add the non-dairy pudding mix to the wet ingredients and whisk until smooth.
Pour the wet ingredients over the bread and mix until the bread is evenly coated.
Fold in the orange zest and juice.
Pour the mixture into a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until the pudding is set and the top is golden brown.
Remove from oven and let cool for 10 minutes before serving.
